thesis: ADMA is a profitable, cash-generative biotech (quality high, dilution risk low, forward P/E 14.2) in a post-earnings uptrend above SMA20/50/200, pulling back into the 12.95-13.30 zone (pre-market 13.25) after the 2026-11-05 gap held with higher lows, and healthcare is a leading sector in this regime. Card stop 12.40 and target 15.9 give R/R about 3.9 from the 13.12 mid entry, but the target needs a break of 14.2, which was rejected on 11/18, and R/R to 14.2 alone is only about 1.5. With a risk-off tape (VIX percentile 0.995) and titles-only news, this supports a small Overweight rather than a Buy.
invalidation: Daily close below 12.40, or a close back under the 20-day SMA (about 12.28) on rising volume.
key_risks: Broad risk-off regime (confidence 0.93, VIX 31.37 at percentile 0.995, QQQ below its 50/200-day): a market-wide flush could gap through the 12.40 stop
Repeated failure at the 14.2 swing high; the 15.9 measured-move target depends on breaking it
CEO and director share sales around 2026-11-16 add supply near 14.2
Revenue growth is only about 5% YoY against net income +37%, so the earnings beat leaned on margins
Short interest about 10% of float and an unverified short-seller attack mention could cause headline volatility
Healthcare concentration in the book (lessons item 6): this may be correlated with other healthcare longs, not an independent bet
Packet inconsistency on the 52-week high (18.0 in levels vs 20.458 in profile); the news feed is titles-only
